description: A PHP class extending ListViewDisplay to render a list view with templating (xtpl), including pagination, sorting, and custom blocks. It processes data for display in a ListView, manages template assignments, and handles pagination link generation.

classes.name: ListViewXTPL
classes.description: A class for rendering list views using XTemplate with support for pagination, sorting arrows, and multiple block processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls parent constructor; initializes the ListViewXTPL instance.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes data and assigns variables to the XTemplate template, including pagination, sorting arrows, and looped rows.

methods.name: processArrows
methods.description: Assigns sorting arrow images and classes to indicate sort order in the list header.

methods.name: processPagination
methods.description: Generates HTML for pagination controls based on current page data and assigns it to the template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the rendered template, with an option to return it as a string instead of echoing.
